rci1_using_msad.detail: Multi-site aggregated dataset; reference cohort aggregated from 14 distinct studies.

rci2_using_epd.detail: Reference cohort built from 14 datasets listed in Supplementary Data 1; none are in the EPD list (e.g., HCP, ABIDE, Cam-CAN, UK Biobank, etc.).
rci2_using_epd.supporting_text: "Dataset 1: OpenNeuro - AHEPA University Hospital Alzheimer Study (AHEPAAD)"; "Dataset 2: OSF - Technical University of Munich Chronic Pain Study (TUMCP)"; "Dataset 3: BASEL"

rci5_n.detail: HC training set used for both spectral power and functional connectivity normative models.
